parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL identifier as chembl_id, canonical SMILES, standard type, standard value, and standard units for exact activity measurements against thyroid hormone receptor CHEMBL1862. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID. Require exact measurements by filtering for standard_relation '=' and non-null standard_value. Include compound structures via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by potency (standard_value ascending). Limit to the first 500 rows.
